QuestInfo.name: Tae Soo and You
QuestInfo.0: Ask Tae Soo if he saw anyone suspicious nearby.
QuestInfo.1: Tae Soo says that the Peach Monkies and Reindeer have become more vicious ever since an unfamiliar group appeared near the farm. He wants you to get rid of them. This definitely seems to be the work of Nobunaga and the Black Wings.\r\nSearch for clues as you hunt Peach Monkies and Reindeer.
QuestInfo.2: You disciplined the Peach Monkies and Reindeer that were traipsing around the peach farm. As expected, you found Oda emblems.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 987,860 Can proceed to the Forest Happenings quest

0.0: Suspicious people? Yes, I did see them. It was right around the time Tae Sang came to inspect the trees.
0.1: The Peach Monkeys and Reindeer were in a tizzy when that group passed through. I've never seen them so worked up. I fear they're becoming a threat to the farm.
0.2: If they don't settle down, this year's harvest will be ruined. They must learn discipline! Can you teach them?

yes.0: Give them a good wallop! I want to see some monkey fur on you when you return.

no.0: I guess you're making the right decision. These majestic trees DO deserve to die at the hands of a feral monkey colony, don't they?

1.0: How's the Peach Monkey and Reindeer situation?

yes.0: That was brilliant. They're as docile as can be now. This year will bring a magnificent harvest after all.
yes.1: What motivation do your enemies have for ruining my precious peaches? There must be something for them to gain.

default.0: Punish the Peach Monkeys and Reindeer before they ruin the farm.
